gloss: weave in chequer or plaited work
definition: [ שָׁבַץ ] verb Pi`el probably weave in chequer or plaited work (Late Hebrew שָׁבַץ ornament a vessel with a pattern ; Syriac (Lexicons) immiscuit , commixtio: see also Lag BN 143 ); — Pi`el Perfect 2 masculine singular וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֫ Exod 28:39 ( P ), and thou shalt chequer (or plait) the tunic (in) byssus. Pu`al Participle masculine plural מְשֻׁבָּצִים זָהָב Exod 28:20 ( P ), inwoven (i.e. set in a chequered or plaited mounting) with gold (-thread) shall they be (of gems).
